name: india-ecommerce-price-tracker
title: India E-commerce Price Tracker
description: Search Indian e-commerce marketplaces for non-personal product price intelligence. Use for competitor price reports, product matching, stock/change monitoring, and market research; returns source, query, title, brand, price, MRP, discount, rating, stock signal, image, and product URL.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the run starts to cover startup and proxy/session setup across sources. Number of events depends on memory (one per GB, minimum one).

product-scraped.eventDescription: Charged once for each clean non-personal product price record saved to the dataset.
